# From The Ground Up Inspections

> From The Ground Up Inspections is a veteran-owned home inspection company based in Port Neches, TX. Founded in 2004 and licensed under TREC #7259-PI, the company has completed 9,000+ inspections and has 400+ Google reviews. It serves Jefferson, Orange, Hardin, Chambers, Tyler, Jasper, and Newton counties and the Bolivar Peninsula. Phone: (409) 363-9868.

## Services

- [Buyer’s Home Inspection](https://ftguinspections.com/buyers-inspection): Buyer's home inspections in Beaumont, Port Neches & Southeast Texas. Know exactly what you're buying before you close. TREC #7259-PI. Veteran-owned since 2004.
- [Seller’s Pre-Listing Inspection](https://ftguinspections.com/sellers-inspection): Get ahead of surprises before you list. Pre-listing home inspections in Beaumont, Port Neches & Southeast Texas. TREC #7259-PI. Veteran-owned since 2004.
- [New Construction Phase Inspections](https://ftguinspections.com/new-construction-inspection): Phase-by-phase new construction inspections in Southeast Texas. Catch deficiencies before they're covered up. Builder-independent. TREC #7259-PI.
- [11-Month Warranty Inspection](https://ftguinspections.com/warranty-inspection): 11-month builder warranty inspection in Southeast Texas. Document defects before your warranty expires. TREC #7259-PI. Veteran-owned. Beaumont, Port Neches & the Golden Triangle.
- [Commercial Inspection](https://ftguinspections.com/commercial-inspection): Commercial property inspections in Southeast Texas. Retail, office, industrial, and multi-family. TREC #7259-PI. Veteran-owned. Serving Beaumont and the Golden Triangle.
- [Foundation Evaluation](https://ftguinspections.com/foundation-evaluation): Foundation elevation measurements and evaluations in Beaumont, Port Neches and Southeast Texas. FTGU partners with Noble Engineering. Crawl bot available.
- [Sewer Scope Inspection](https://ftguinspections.com/sewer-scope-inspection): Sewer scope inspections in Beaumont, Port Neches & Southeast Texas. High-resolution camera inspection of your main sewer line. TREC #7259-PI. Veteran-owned since 2004.
- [Pool and Spa Inspection](https://ftguinspections.com/pool-spa-inspection): Pool and spa inspections in Beaumont, Port Neches & Southeast Texas. Evaluate structure, equipment, and safety before you buy. TREC #7259-PI. Veteran-owned.
- [Well and Septic Inspection](https://ftguinspections.com/well-septic-inspection): Well and septic inspections in Southeast Texas. Evaluate private water and sewer systems before buying rural or acreage property. TREC #7259-PI. Veteran-owned.
- [Water Testing](https://ftguinspections.com/water-testing): Water sample testing for private wells in Southeast Texas. VA and FHA compliant. Certified lab results. TREC #7259-PI. Veteran-owned. Beaumont, Port Neches & the Golden Triangle.
- [WDI and Termite Inspection](https://ftguinspections.com/wdi-termite): Arrange a WDI or termite inspection in Southeast Texas through FTGU. Inspections are performed by Champion Termite & Pest Control.

- [Landscape Irrigation (Sprinkler) System Inspection](https://ftguinspections.com/services): We operate the system and report on visible components and observed performance as an optional add-on to a home inspection, following the TREC Standards of Practice for optional systems.
